t: Hannitzrak lebasar beyom tob heak yitnaheg veseder melichato
s: Hannitzrak lebasar beyom tob heak yitnaheg veseder melichato ubo k"b seipim: debarim rabbim aseru beyom tob mishshum gezerat miqqach umimkar. Ketzad? Chabura sherotzin liqqach behema shelema mehattabbach — en poseqin lo damim aleha, ella hattabbach mebi shette behemot shavot veomer lahem: reu shezzo kazo, vehen loqechin achat mehen veshochatim umechalleqim benehem belo hatalat goral kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"b ayyen sham, uleachar yom tob yodeim kamma deme hashsheniyya, vekol echad veechad noten deme chelqo. Velo yomru halloqechin lattabbach: mah sheatta notel lemachar bead zo anu nitten leka bead zo shennishchot hayyom, mippene shezzehu sekum miqqach sheasur lehazkir beyom tob.

Velo yomar adam lehalloqechin: hareni shuttap immakem besela, dehaynu sheettol immakem cheleq basar sheshshaveh sela, mippene sheasur lehazkir sekum damim beyom tob, ella omer lahem: hareni shuttap immakem lishlish habbasar o lirbia, deaz eno nikkar venireh kemiqqach umimkar ella keshuttaput.

Abal asur lomar lehannokri: hareni shuttap immeka lishlish o lirbia, shehaddabar yadua sheen regilut lehishtattep im hannokri, venikkar shehu miqqach umimkar ap sheeno mazkir sekum damim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bedabar sheen shiur miqqacho yadua, kegon basar sheen kol habbehemot shavot, abal dabar sheshshiur miqqacho yadua, kegon betzim veegozim — muttar liqqach im hannokri im eno mazkir lo sekum damim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqy"z. Vaapillu im mazkir lo sekum damim — yesh mattirin, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"g, ayyen sham hattaam. Veyesh omerim daapillu dabar sheen shiur miqqacho yadua — muttar liqqach apillu min hannokri im en mazkir lo sekum damim. Vetob lehachamir kisbara harishona.

En loqechin basar mehattabbach bepissuq damim, sheyyomar lo: ten li besela o bishtayim. Veken lo yomar lo: hareni shuttap immeka besela, kede sheyyehe nireh keshuttaput velo kemiqqach umimkar, demikkol maqom, kevan shemmazkir lo sekum damim — nikkar shehu miqqach umimkar. Ella hattabbach mechalleq lahem shelishiyyot o rebiiyyot, o kepi derek hachalaqim shedderek lechalleq bair, belo hazkarat sekum damim, umebi shette behemot shavot veomer lahem: reu shezzo kazo, ulemachar shamin hannisheret, ukepi sheshshava kak yipreu lo, kemo shennitbaer lemala.

Asur lishqol beyom tob, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol. Vaapillu lishqol basar bebeto leda kamma yebashshel — asur. Vaapillu eno medaqdeq bemishqalo raq pochet meat o mosip meat — asur. Veken asur liqqach beyad achat hammishqal ubeyad hashsheniyya basar leshaer mishqalo. Veken asur lishqol maneh keneged maneh sheyyodea kebar mishqalah.

Umuttar lishqol beyado, shelloqeach hachatika beyado umeshaer kamma mishqalah. Vetabbach uman sheyyodea lekavven leshaer betzimtzum — asur lo lishqol chatikat basar beyad kede lemokrah, abal im eno rotzeh lemokrah raq shehu shoqelah leda kamma yebashshel — muttar leshoqlah beyad apillu hu tabbach uman.
Tabbach uman shehu yodea lekavven bederek chatikato lechattek litera o chatzi litera — chotek kedarko veeno choshesh, apillu chotek kede limkor, kevan sheeno shoqel beyad.

Keli sheyyesh bo shenatot venoten bo meat mayim umanniach habbasar bammayim ukeshehammayim maggiim ad hashshenatot yodea kamma literot yesh babbasar — asur laasot ken beyom tob, apillu pichet meat o hosip meat, mippene shennikkar haddabar shemmekavven lemidda.

Asur lehanniach basar bekap moznayim. Vaapillu eno rotzeh leshoqlo, raq shehu mannicho sham kede leshomro min haakbarim, im hakkap moznayim hu taluy bemaqom shergilin lishqol sham — asur, mippene shennireh kerotzeh lishqol.

Ap al pi sheasur lehazkir shem damim beyom tob, mikkol maqom shem mishqal muttar lehazkir, dehaynu sheyyomar lo: ten li litera basar, deeno mekavven lammishqal ella lomar lo kamma hu tzarik, kemo shennitbaer gabbe shem minyan besimman shk"g, ayyen sham.

En noqebin neqeb bebasar besakkin kede litloto bo kederek shehu oseh bechol, keshemmoker basar oseh bo bet yad venoteno lalloqeach leholiko lebeto, lepi shebbeyom tob tzarik leshannot, laasot hekker sheen miqqach umimkar muttar bo. Ulepikak en noqebo besakkin ella beetzbao, kede leshannot. Veim rotzeh laasot bo simman shello yachalipennu adam — muttar lenoqbo apillu besakkin.

Molegin et harosh veet haraglayim berotechin kede lehasir hassear, umehabhabin otan beur, vetomenin otan beremetz, shekkol ellu hen melakot shelletzorek akila. Abal en topelin otan besid, velo becharsit, velo baadama, mippene shennireh kimabbed. Veen gozezin otan bemisparayim, mippene shennireh keoseh letzorek hassear.

Muttar limloach habbasar beyom tob kede lehotzi et damo ap al pi shehaya epshar lemolcho meereb yom tob, mishshum deim haya molecho meereb yom tob — haya tzarik lehashhoto bemelach ad lemachar, deim lo ken haya mitqalqel, vedabar yadua hu keshehabbasar shohe bemelach hu mepig tamo, lepikak muttar limloach beyom tob habbasar sherotzeh leekol bo bayyom. Vaapillu habbasar sheeno rotzeh leoklo beyom tob, im choshesh shemma yasriach — muttar lemolcho beyachad im habbasar sherotzeh leekol, kevan shettorach echad hu toreach lekol habbasar, veeno mosip tircha yetera bishbil melichat habbasar sheeno rotzeh leekol beyom tob, shehare moleach hakkol beyachad. Veap al pi shehu mosip qetzat tircha, shehare tzarik lehappek kol chatika vachatika bipne atzmah kede lemolcham betzad hashsheni, mikkol maqom kevan sheissur melichat basar beshabbat veyom tob eno ella middibre soperim, demin hattora en ibbud baokalin kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"a, lepikak heqellu bo.

Vaapillu im eno moleach hakkol beyachad ella zeh achar zeh — muttar, al yede sheyyaarim al kol chatika lomar: mizzo ani chapetz leekol hayyom, umolechah, dehaynu leachar shemmalach chatika achat leoklah beyom tob — omer: chabertah areba alay beyoter leoklah hayyom, umolechah gam ken, veken yaaseh bekol chatika vachatika sheyyimlach. Veap al pi shehaya epshar lo limloach meereb yom tob, velama hittiru lo dabar zeh? Kede shello yimmana millishchot mechamat sheyyachush lahapagat taam habbasar hannimlach meereb yom tob, veyarbeh besimchat yom tob.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Qodem akilat seuddat shacharit, abal leachar seuddat shacharit asur limloach basar kede shello yasriach. Vaapillu rotzeh lebashshel veleekol chatika mimmennu umoleach zo hachatika im shear hachatikot beyachad — ap al pi ken asur limloach shear hachatikot, dekevan sheeno tzarik leekol zo hachatika, veeno okelah ella kede lehattir lo melichat shear hachatikot — hare zo haarama.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheeno moleach ella mishshum chashash shemma yasriach, abal im yadua lo shebbevadday yasriach — muttar lemolcho apillu achar akila, mishshum hepsed mamono, vaapillu zeh achar zeh, al yede sheyyaarim al kol chatika lomar: mizzo okal hayyom, veokel kezayit meachat mehen. Velo hittiru dabar zeh limloach achar akila, ella kesheshshachat beyom tob, kede shello yimmana millishchot, abal im shechatah meereb yom tob, kevan shehaya epshar limloach qodem yom tob — asur limloach basar sheeno tzarik lo beyom tob, ella im ken molecho qodem akila, veal derek shennitbaer.

Vaapillu qodem seuddat shacharit eno rashshay limloach habbasar sheeno rotzeh leoklo beyom tob ella melicha shehi kede lehotzi et haddam, abal leachar shennimlach habbasar melicha zo — asur lo lachazor ulemolcho paam shenit kede shello yasriach, apillu im molecho beyachad im habbasar sherotzeh leoklo beyom tob, dekevan shehabbasar sherotzeh leoklo hayyom en tzarik limlicha zo hashsheniyya, shehare yebashshelennu miyyad, veim ken eno toreach ella bishbil habbasar sheeno rotzeh leoklo beyom tob. Ella ketzad yaaseh shello yasriach achar shemmelacho lehotzi et damo? Lo yedichennu miyyad, ella yashhennu bemilcho ad qarob ley"b shaot kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman a', veachar kak yedichennu. Ubelel yom tob sheni yakol lachazor ulemolcho al yede sheyyaarim al kol chatika lomar: mizzo okal lemachar, abal beyom tob sheni beshacharit asur limloach al yede haarama zo, shehare habbasar sherotzeh leekol yebashshelennu miyyad, veen tzarik melicha.

Muttar lenaqqer behema beyom tob, ap al pi shennishchata meereb yom tob vehaya epshar lenaqqerah qodem yom tob, lepi shehanniqqur en bo melaka gemura, ap al pi shehu borer umaprid okel meokel — en bekak kelum kevan shehakkol min echad ella shehattora asarattu baakila, veen issur borer shayyak ella beborer umaprid shene minim zeh mizzeh, o pesolet mittok haokel shehen keen shene minim. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob leshannot beniqqur behema shennishchata meereb yom tob vehaya epshar lenaqqerah qodem yom tob, dehaynu sheyyenaqqer beqardom o beqopitz o shinnuy acher. Abal im i epshar lo leshannot — muttar lenaqqer kedarko, apillu cheleq haachorayim sheyyesh torach rab binqirato, kevan shehu tzorek "okel nepesh".

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bebasar sherotzeh leoklo beyom tob, abal basar sheeno rotzeh leoklo beyom tob — asur lenaqqero beyom tob, shehare hu toreach letzorek chol, ella im ken choshesh shello yasriach habbasar verotzeh lemolcho beyom tob al yede haarama veal derek shennitbaer, vei epshar lemolcho qodem hanniqqur kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman s"h — azay muttar lenaqqero gam ken al yede haarama, dehaynu leachar shenniqqer chatika achat leoklah hayyom omer: chabertah areba alay yoter leoklah hayyom, vechozer umenaqqerah gam ken. Velo hittiru lo dabar zeh ella keshennishchata beyom tob, kede shello yimmana millishchot. Abal im nishchata meereb yom tob vehaya epshar lenaqqerah qodem yom tob — asur lenaqqer beyom tob ella habbasar sherotzeh leekol hayyom, shehare hanniqqur eno mepig taam habbasar kelal, veadderabba kesheeno menuqqar masriach yoter bimhera, veim ken haya lo lenaqqerah qodem yom tob. Vaapillu im nishchata beyom tob — asur lenaqqer al yede haarama zo leachar shekkebar akal seuddat shacharit, mittaam shennitbaer lemala.

Basar menuqqar sheshshaha belo melicha shene yamim qodem yom tob veyom hashshelishi chal lihyot beyom tob, veim lo yishrennu bemayim bo bayyom yehe asur leoklo ki im tzali kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman s"t — muttar lishroto bemayim, ap shekkebar akal seuddato veeno tzarik kelal lebasar zeh beyom tob, mikkol maqom kevan sherauy leoklo hayyom, shehare kebar niqqero meereb yom tob — muttar gam ken lishroto, kederek shemmuttar letaltelo mechamat shehu rauy laakila bo bayyom. Veap al pi sheasur laasot shum maaseh letzorek chol ap sheen bo melaka, kegon lehadiach hakkelim uleshapshepan kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"g vetaq"t, mikkol maqom, kevan sheeno mediach habbasar beyadayv raq sheshshoreh oto bemayim — eno domeh lahadachat kelim sheoseh maaseh beyadayim shemmedichan.

Ap al pi shehabbasar sherotzeh leoklo beyom tob muttar lemolcho ap al pi shehaya epshar lo lemolcho meereb yom tob, mikkol maqom dagim sheqqareu otam meereb yom tob — asur lemolchan beyom tob, shehaddagim mashbichin kesheshshohin bemelach, veim ken haya lo lemolchan meereb yom tob. Umikkol maqom, muttar latet melach letok hammachabat shemmebashshelin otam bah, deen issur bimlicha ella mishshum gezerat ibbud, vezeh en shayyak betabshil shennoten hammelach letok hammayim.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemine dagim shemmashbichim bemilchan, abal mine dagim shebbesaram rak umitqalqelim kesheshshohim bemelach — muttar lemolchan beyom tob ap al pi shehaya epshar lo lemolchan beereb yom tob, vedinan kimlichat basar lekol dabar.
